name: france-public-finances
title: French public finances: debt, revenue and spending
description: General government debt, fiscal balances, revenue and expenditure, and spending by function. Official statistical snapshots for a DataPressr investigation.

licenses.name: Eurostat reuse policy
licenses.title: Eurostat statistical data reuse with source acknowledgement

sources.title: Eurostat: government revenue, expenditure and main aggregates (gov_10a_main)
Eurostat: general government expenditure by function (gov_10a_exp)
INSEE: quarterly Maastricht debt, Q2 2026, release 29 September 2026

resources.name: fiscal-accounts
resources.title: Annual government revenue, expenditure and balances

fields.name: country_code
fields.description: Eurostat geography: FR, DE, ES, IT or EU27_2020. The EU is an aggregate, not another country to add to the others.

fields.name: country
fields.description: Official geography label.

fields.name: year
fields.description: Annual accounting period.

fields.name: indicator
fields.description: ESA 2010 code. TE expenditure; TR total revenue; B9 balance (negative is deficit); D41PAY interest; D2REC, D5REC, D91REC taxes; D61REC net social contributions; D995REC collection adjustment. Other indicators describe economic types of spending and overlap with functional spending.

fields.name: indicator_label
fields.description: Eurostat indicator label; components and aggregates must not all be summed together.

fields.name: unit
fields.description: MIO_EUR: millions of current euros; PC_GDP: percentage of GDP. Never sum across units.

fields.name: value
fields.description: Official observation; empty means not supplied, never zero. Values retain source precision.

fields.name: status_flag
fields.description: Eurostat observation flag, preserved verbatim; p indicates provisional, m missing value, b a break in series, e estimated. Empty means no flag was supplied, not necessarily final data.

fields.name: source_updated
fields.description: Eurostat dataset update timestamp, as supplied; denotes the snapshot vintage, not an observation date.

fields.name: year
fields.description: Annual accounting period; 2025 appears in the API dimension but has no French observations in this snapshot.

fields.name: function_code
fields.description: COFOG code, with TOTAL plus division and group codes.

fields.name: function_name
fields.description: Official function label. Social protection excludes health in COFOG.

fields.name: level
fields.description: 0 total; 1 division; 2 group. Sum only mutually exclusive categories at the same level.

fields.name: parent_code
fields.description: Parent COFOG code, empty for TOTAL.

fields.name: unit
fields.description: MIO_EUR: millions of current euros; PC_GDP: percentage of GDP. Never sum across units.

fields.name: value
fields.description: Official observation; empty means not supplied, never zero. Values retain source precision.

fields.name: status_flag
fields.description: Eurostat observation flag, preserved verbatim; p indicates provisional, m missing value, b a break in series, e estimated. Empty means no flag was supplied, not necessarily final data.

fields.name: source_updated
fields.description: Eurostat dataset update timestamp, as supplied; denotes the snapshot vintage, not an observation date.

resources.name: quarterly-debt
resources.title: French Maastricht debt, quarterly (latest INSEE vintage)

fields.name: period
fields.description: Quarter in YYYY-Qn format.

fields.name: period_end
fields.description: Quarter-end date; debt is a stock, not an annual spending flow.

fields.name: gross_debt_eur_billions
fields.description: Consolidated general government Maastricht gross debt, nominal billions of euros.

fields.name: net_debt_eur_billions
fields.description: INSEE net debt: gross debt less financial assets in the corresponding instruments; not net worth and not net of all public assets.

fields.name: gross_debt_pct_gdp
fields.description: Gross debt as percentage of annual GDP, using INSEE quarterly denominator methodology; not percentage of one quarter GDP.

fields.name: source_release_date
fields.description: Date of the INSEE release containing the full revised series.
